Wow, the board changed significantly after moving right 5 times! The green blocks have moved/changed positions. Let me analyze the new state:
Green blocks (N):
- (13,25)-(17,29), (13,31)-(17,35), (13,37)-(17,41) - 3 blocks at top middle
- (31,13)-(35,17), (31,19)-(35,23), (31,25)-(35,29) - 3 blocks at middle left
- (37,13)-(41,17), (37,19)-(41,23), (37,25)-(41,29) - 3 blocks at bottom left
- (55,49)-(59,53) - 1 block at bottom right
Total: 10 green blocks
Player (b): (37,44)-(40,45) - moved from (37,15)-(40,16) to (37,44)-(40,45)
Yellow (Y): (38,46)-(39,46) - moved with player
So the player moved 29 columns to the right (from col 15 to col 44). But wait, I only moved 5 times. Each RIGHT must move the player by about 6 columns (29/5 ≈ 5.8).
Wait, that doesn't make sense. Let me recalculate. The player was at (37,15)-(40,16), which is cols 15-16. After 5 RIGHT actions, the player is at (37,44)-(40,45), which is cols 44-45. That's a movement of 29 columns in 5 actions, or about 5.8 columns per action.
Actually, looking at the image, the player seems to be near the right edge of the sky blue path. The green blocks have also moved or appeared in new positions.
This is very different from what I expected. The green blocks seem to move or respawn when the player moves. This suggests the green blocks are not static obstacles but dynamic elements that change based on the player's position.
Let me look at the image more carefully:
- Top: 3 green blocks in a row
- Middle left: 6 green blocks in a 2x3 grid
- Bottom left: 3 green blocks in a row (but these are on the sky blue path)
- Bottom right: 1 green block
- Player: near the right edge of the middle section
Wait, looking at the green block at (37,13)-(41,17), this is at the same row as the player (37-40). The player is at (37,44)-(40,45), so the green block is to the left of the player.
Let me try clicking on the green blocks to see if they can be removed from this new configuration.
